title: Fix tests/writing.spec.ts strict-mode clash with the new open-beside button
description: Found by T127 (U21) step 4: tests/writing.spec.ts:2 'writer journey' fails deterministically (also on a lone rerun). Line 30-33 clicks getByRole('button', {name: /The first paragraph belongs here./}) which now matches two buttons in the sidebar fragment row: the entry-main button and the new open-beside button (aria-label 'Open <title> beside', src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx ~568). Playwright strict mode violation. Wave 2 added the button but did not update the spec. Suggested fix: scope the locator to .entry-main (or add exact name), test-side only; confirm the rest of the spec then passes. Logs: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui2-final/step4-playwright.log and step4-rerun-writing.log. Not fixed in T127 per plan.

review.note: APPROVE (final reviewer agent-ddfd, Claude Opus, not the owner). git diff tests/writing.spec.ts is exactly one line: the locator regex is anchored to ^The first paragraph belongs here so it no longer matches the new Open <title> beside button (ProjectSidebar.tsx:469) and still matches the fragment row entry-main button. Test-only, no product code. Fail-first: deterministic strict-mode failure in ui2-final/step4-playwright.log and lone rerun step4-rerun-writing.log; after the fix step4-rerun-writing-after-T130.log 3 passed 0 failed on the same dist. mtime sweep: this file is the only non-generated file changed after U21 began.
